decisions.reason: Naval vessel lighting is a certification-heavy niche with long procurement and service cycles, so a line launched in 2023 is very likely to stay available.
The second-generation general interior luminaire is core to the firm's building lighting business and has only recently been introduced.
The microprismatic pendant is presented as a flagship of the firm's direction toward efficient, glare-free office lighting, so withdrawal is unlikely.
The HMI discharge-lamp searchlight sits against the firm's LED strategy and could be phased out, but marine customers need continuity, so it stays for now.
The marine searchlight line serves robust specialist customers with long lifecycle requirements and rounds out the firm's marine offering.
